name: statusline
description: A status line as a mod: 5-hour and weekly limits, context, tokens and cost above the prompt; folder, branch, model, session name and id under it.

ends.title: Pill ends
ends.description: round draws half-disc caps in the terminal (they need a font with Powerline symbols, which Ghostty bundles); square draws plain boxes that work in any font. The desktop app always draws square chips.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: nerd draws Nerd Font icons in the terminal (JetBrains Mono Nerd Font and Ghostty carry them); plain draws Unicode arrows that work in any font. Other surfaces always use plain.
